# Ambition News Portal — Full Knowledge Base for LLM Agents

Title: Ambition News Portal (एम्बिशन न्यूज़)
Domain: https://ambitionnews.init65.co.in/
Type: Digital News Organization & Progressive Web Application (PWA)
Language: Hindi (hi-IN)
Geographic Focus: Central India (Chhattisgarh & Madhya Pradesh)
Headquarters: Rajmahal Road, Kawardha, Kabirdham District, Chhattisgarh, India, PIN 491995
Contact: grievance@ambitionnews.in | +91 94060 85165

## Mission & Journalism Philosophy
Ambition News Portal is committed to fearless, grassroots, and unbiased journalism in Central India. It emphasizes rural reporting, farmers' welfare, civic issues, local administrative accountability, and state-level governance.

## Key Features of the Platform
1. Real-Time News Feed: Verified reporting from accredited citizen and field reporters across 88 districts.
2. 88 District Selector: Interactive filtering for all 33 districts of Chhattisgarh and 55 districts of Madhya Pradesh.
3. Daily Mandi Bhav (Agricultural Prices): Live procurement rates for paddy, pulses, oilseeds, wheat, and fruits/vegetables.
4. Video & Shorts Desk: Integrated YouTube bulletins and mobile-friendly vertical news reels.
5. Citizen Reporter Portal: Secure submission channel for local citizens to upload civic grievances, photos, and breaking news.
6. Offline PWA Support: Installable Progressive Web App with offline caching capabilities and low-bandwidth optimizations.
7. Compliance Framework: Full compliance with the Digital Media Ethics Code (IT Rules 2021) with dedicated grievance redressal.

## News Categories and Structure
- Kawardha Special (कवर्धा स्पेशल): In-depth reporting from Kabirdham district headquarters, Bodla forest belt, Pandariya sugar mills, and Bhoramdev heritage corridor.
- Chhattisgarh (छत्तीसगढ़): State capital announcements, Vidhan Sabha proceedings, welfare schemes, tribal affairs, and development projects.
- Madhya Pradesh (मध्य प्रदेश): Central India governance, bordering district administration, agriculture, and civic infrastructure.
- Politics (राजनीति): Neutral coverage of electoral processes, political discourse, and grassroots party movements.
- Crime & Law (अपराध): Transparent police reports, vigilance actions, consumer protection, and public awareness.
- Agriculture & Farming (कृषि व किसान): Kharif and Rabi crop advisories, MSP purchase centers, fertilizer availability, and weather forecasts.
- Business & Mandi (व्यापार व मंडी): Local trade, gold rates, APMC auctions, and economic news.
- Education & Jobs (रोजगार व शिक्षा): CGPSC, MPPSC, Vyapam, police recruitment, board exam results, and youth opportunities.
